title: Choose Public Transport
tip: Use buses, trains or shared transportation whenever possible instead of travelling alone by car.

title: Walk Short Distances
tip: For short journeys, walking or cycling can reduce emissions while keeping you active.

title: Share Your Ride
tip: Carpooling can reduce the emissions produced per person during a journey.

title: Switch Off Unused Devices
tip: Turn off lights, fans, computers and other appliances when they are not needed.

title: Use Energy-Efficient Appliances
tip: Energy-efficient appliances can reduce electricity consumption over time.

title: Use Natural Light
tip: Open curtains and use natural daylight instead of artificial lighting when possible.

title: Reduce Food Waste
tip: Plan meals before shopping and store food properly to avoid unnecessary waste.

title: Try Plant-Based Meals
tip: Adding more plant-based meals to your diet can help reduce the carbon footprint associated with food.

title: Buy Local Food
tip: Choosing locally produced food when practical can reduce transportation-related emissions.

title: Reuse Before Recycling
tip: Try to reuse products and containers before sending them for recycling.

title: Avoid Single-Use Plastic
tip: Carry reusable bags, bottles and containers to reduce disposable plastic consumption.

title: Separate Your Waste
tip: Keep recyclable materials separate from general waste to make recycling easier.

title: Start Small
tip: Small sustainable habits repeated every day can create a meaningful long-term impact.

title: Track Your Progress
tip: Regularly checking your carbon footprint can help you understand which habits have the biggest impact.

title: Set Monthly Goals
tip: Choose realistic environmental goals every month and track how consistently you achieve them.
